name: PaddleOCR
scope: Scanned PDF and image layout recognition with DOCX export. No hosted AI key.

name: MinerU
license: Custom Apache-based terms and model terms
scope: Complex-layout Markdown and JSON extraction. Attribution is shown in the UI; operator must review current thresholds and model terms.

name: Docling
scope: Reading order, tables, Markdown, HTML and JSON export.

name: Gotenberg
license: MIT; bundled engines retain their licenses
scope: Office to PDF, Chromium HTML printing and PDF/A remediation.

name: Stirling PDF
scope: Discovers file-processing forms from the installed OpenAPI specification. Key-dependent, account/admin and unsupported structured forms are excluded; the full upstream app remains available separately.

name: BentoPDF
license: AGPL-3.0 or commercial; separate component terms
scope: All 114 tools in the reviewed inventory are listed. The unmodified self-hosted workspace runs separately; it is not copied into or relicensed with this Next.js application. Paid Hyper Compress/Kura rights are not granted.

name: GenOffice
scope: Local Office/PDF format conversion. AI image generation, hosted models and account-linked features are excluded.

name: Filee
license: MIT; bundled engines have separate terms
scope: Universal conversion through filee convert. Actual format support depends on the installed engine; no claim is made that every format pair converts.

name: Marker
scope: Local Markdown, HTML and JSON extraction. Hosted LLM enhancement is excluded. Model-weight eligibility must be verified before enabling.

name: PDFium / EmbedPDF engine
license: MIT wrapper; bundled PDFium/component notices retained
integration: Engine helper in our own editor
scope: PDFium WebAssembly 2.15.1 renders and modifies PDF objects behind our original React interface. No upstream editor app, launcher or branding is shipped. A checksum-pinned Inter font is embedded for replacement text; its SIL OFL notice is retained.

name: ONLYOFFICE Docs
license: AGPL-3.0 Community Edition; edition limits apply
scope: Editable DOCX, XLSX and PPTX sessions. No paid license or external API key is supplied. An internal JWT secret protects document callbacks.

name: PDF.js
scope: First-page previews and PDF text/coordinate extraction. This does not verify digital signatures.

name: qpdf
scope: Linearized PDFs for progressive loading.

name: pdfcpu
scope: PDF structural validation and optimization.

name: OCRmyPDF
scope: Searchable scanned PDFs using Tesseract. Included OCR languages: English, Hindi, German, French and Spanish.

name: pdf-lib
scope: Local page organization, form filling, annotations and standard metadata cleanup.

name: pypdf
scope: PDF structure, password-based decryption/encryption, attachments and text-based conversion.

name: pdfplumber
scope: Text-layer tables used by editable Word, Excel and CSV extraction.

name: DocVortex
scope: Structured PDF-to-DOCX with native text, headings, tables and images; semantic HTML packages. No model download or hosted API. OCR is a separate local OCRmyPDF step.

name: pdf2docx / PyMuPDF
scope: Alternative editable layout reconstruction; default off pending operator license review. No hosted API or key. Upstream pdf2docx is no longer actively maintained; limitations and earlier benchmark remain visible.
